title: One setup decision at a time
need: The TUI teaches the human directly. Agent mode provides a structured question, allowed answers, links and guidance, which the agent translates for the human. The first question discloses machine-wide unattended approval and sandbox settings and worker bypass. Without a preset or saved checkout, project.mode precedes sign-in and GitHub; its saved answer selects the project path after connection. Git installer handoffs include xcode-select --install and recheck Git before proceeding.
surface: TUI setup; yoke setup --agent JSON questions answered with --answer KEY=VALUE
gap: Live harness proof that an agent relays each question to a person through install and first-work remains pending.
review: Source and focused regression tests; no live pass asserted.
